rows.text: when dword `[rcx]` is not 3 it calls `002001F0` with the incoming registers, stores 3 to `[rcx]`, calls `00210EC0(0x38)` and, when that returns non-null, calls `001EDF00(rsp+0x50, 'EASTL map')` and then `001FE510(block, result)` and stores that call's return to qword `[rcx+8]` (a null block stores 0 there); on both paths it then tail-jumps to `001FF4F0` with `rcx` = qword `[rcx+8]` and `rdx` = the incoming `rdx`

returns 0 when dword `[rcx+0x48]` is zero; otherwise it reads node `n` = qword `[rcx+0x30]` and `v` = qword `[n+0x20]`, decrements `[rcx+0x48]`, calls `0016D6D0(n)` and `0016DA60(n, rcx+0x28)`, calls the vtable slot `+0x18` of the object at `rcx+0x50` with that object, `n` and 0x28, calls `00199DB0(rcx+0x58, rsp+0x28, rsp+0x50, low byte of v)`, and returns `00225160(v)` when `v` is non-null, else 0

calls `007AB460(rsp+0x20)` and returns -1 when that is negative; otherwise it writes 3 to dword `[p]`, dword `[rcx]` to `[p+8]`, `xmm1` to float `[p+0xc]`, `xmm2` to float `[p+0x10]` and `r9d` to dword `[p+0x14]` of the returned record `p` and returns `007AB550(p)`; the stack cookie is checked through `00808C40`
